author: PaolaM0R
quote: The incredible art direction in this game does justice to what is considered the best video game ever made. The level of attention to detail that Nintendo has shown is something I had never experienced before; it feels like living inside a moving painting. I loved this game five years ago when I first played it on the 3DS, and Nintendo has managed to make me love it even more today. What a masterpiece.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: PaolaM0R
quote: The number of bugs you encounter during gameplay is embarrassing for a game with this kind of budget. Rockstar Games couldn’t even manage to stabilize the frame rate, which, in certain parts of the game, drops well below the 30 fps promised on PS5. We really need to stop normalizing spending 100 dollars just to be beta testers for a multi-billion-dollar company.
